intents.name: Battery and Power Issues
intents.definition: Customer messages reporting rapid battery drain, unexpected device power-offs, failure to charge, or overheating.
examples: Dear . My battery is draining again. It was on 10% - I blinked and now at 1%.....🤔
Mon portable il charged plus du coup j’ai appeler : -Bjr mon iPhone ne charge plus.
why is my iPhone 8 going dead within two hours???

intents.name: Keyboard and Autocorrect Glitches
intents.definition: Customer messages specifically reporting text input bugs, character replacement errors, or symbol replacement glitches when typing.
examples: can y’all fix you’re “I️” situation.
text correction is not working for the letter I.
Why tf are all my “I’s” turning into question marks?!

intents.name: OS Performance and Stability
intents.definition: Customer messages regarding general system lag, freezing, unexpected reboots, or app crashes, often following a software update.
examples: iOS 11 is definitely not for iPhone 6 so many bugs and phone lags so much. seems to be doing nothing for iPhone 6
it’s by far the worst update you released! Most of the apps freeze on my phone. It’s just frustrating 😤
my phone is constantly restarting since the last update, how can this be solved please ???

intents.name: Connectivity and Call Failures
intents.definition: Customer messages detailing problems with Wi-Fi dropping, Bluetooth pairing, cellular connection, or making/receiving phone calls.
examples: haven’t been able to make a phone call since upgrading to iOS 11.0.3. Says call was made, but no connection. How do I fix??
Hi my iPad Pro 9,7” is dropping my Wi-Fi connection, it’s my only device doing it, any clues?
Since the newest update my MAC won't stay connected to my mouse & kb (bluetooth). Help !?!

intents.name: Data Recovery and Syncing
intents.definition: Customer messages seeking help recovering lost files, deleted photos or contacts, missing backups, or fixing iCloud sync issues.
examples: need your support to recover my iPhone without loosing my data.
Apple Music deleted a pile of my music and won’t let me play it or redownload it?🤦🏻‍♂️
my phone deleted all my contacts TWICE so I have no ones number

intents.name: Billing and Subscriptions
intents.definition: Customer inquiries or disputes regarding unauthorized charges, subscription cancellations, gift card usage, or App Store/Apple Music fees.
examples: Fuck you for still charging my card on an app subscription I cancelled 4 days ago
why was I charged 9.99 for a free Apple Music trial
I want to buy a Macbook and I see I get a £120 gift card. Can I use this gift card to buy the Macbook or do I have to use it on another item?

intents.name: Hardware Damage and Physical Repair
intents.definition: Customer reports of physically damaged devices, liquid spills, component defects, or inquiries regarding physical repairs and AppleCare coverage.
examples: Just cracked my watch screen just before boarding. Only under 3 weeks old. 😭😭😭
my iPhone 6 fell into the sea, and I don't know what to do. I took it out, but I cannot open it
If I purchase Apple Care, will my repairs be free? Does Apple Care cover all repairs or only certain kinds.

intents.name: Security and Fraud Reporting
intents.definition: Customer inquiries regarding suspicious phishing emails, scam messages, potential security breaches, or account verification concerns.
examples: received a suspicious email masked as Apple - could I forward to your spam team? Not sure what to do other than block
How often does this scam happen with apple users? Cause this is at least the fifth message I've received like this cc:
is this a scam?

intents.name: Product Specifications and Features
intents.definition: General customer inquiries regarding device usage how-tos, feature capabilities, hardware compatibility, or recycling policies.
examples: What is the best way to dispose of old charging cables? Will Apple store recycle them?
Is the iPhone X compatible with existing 7 Plus Lightning docks and power packs, including the ones made by Belkin?
hi just wondering is the Apple Watch series 1 waterproof thanks

intents.name: Store and Support Experience
intents.definition: Customer feedback, complaints, or scheduling requests regarding Genius Bar appointments, Apple Store visits, or phone support experiences.
examples: On the phone with your "support" team. I have been transferred 5x and hung up on twice. What is your problem!!!
Can someone tell me how to book an appointment with one of those geniuses at the Apple store. Thanks.
Missed a call regarding survey feedback from Apple Eldon Square. They refuse to answer my call from the number they left.

notes: A huge portion of this sample consists of complaints about a specific iOS 11 release bug where typing 'I' auto-corrected to a question mark symbol; while technically a software defect, its overwhelming volume justifies a distinct 'Keyboard and Autocorrect Glitches' category for specific handling/auto-replies. There are also several non-actionable or off-topic messages (e.g., jokes, general venting like 'wtf?', or personal updates like 'Now I can't stop sneezing') as well as non-English tweets (French, Spanish, German, Turkish) that would either fall into an 'Other / Unactionable' bucket or require language routing prior to intent classification.
